trust_decision.summary: Whether the SignatureHeaderSize vendor bytes that head each EFI_SIGNATURE_LIST are treated as opaque (skipped) or as signature entries (trusted) is decided per list inside parseEfiSignatureList, in both the X509 and the SHA256 branch; getting it wrong turns attacker-chosen event-log bytes into trusted PK/KEK/db/dbx keys or permitted hashes exposed by ParseSecurebootState.

landing_point.why: The advisory names parseEfiSignatureList and hash injection, so an engineer opens that one function; the hash loop at :407 (and its X509 twin at :388) is where SignatureHeaderSize is ignored, and the function is only 100 lines from the surrounding header checks.

fix_sites.module_kind: internal binary parser (unexported function, inserted guard: SignatureHeaderSize must leave room for at least one entry)
internal binary parser (certX509SigGUID entry loop start offset)
internal binary parser (hashSHA256SigGUID entry loop start offset)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The summary only says hashes, so the certX509 signature branch (and any non-SHA256 signature type) can be argued out of scope and left starting at offset 0.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Accepting a list that carries a non-zero vendor SignatureHeaderSize instead of rejecting it: the pinned parser only bounds that field at 1 MiB and then walks successive concatenated lists in one variable, so an over-broad fix that errors on any non-zero header size (or that stops after the first list) breaks legitimate firmware logs and makes ParseSecurebootState fail on a healthy machine.

O6_input_shapes: SignatureHeaderSize > 0 on a hashSHA256SigGUID list - bytes must be skipped, not returned as hashes
SignatureHeaderSize > 0 on a certX509SigGUID list - bytes must be skipped, not parsed as certificates
SignatureHeaderSize equal to the entire remaining list space - rejected at the boundary

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second, independent secure-boot parser in package attest-tool/internal/eventlog that keeps PK/KEK/DB/DBX as raw []byte and carries a TODO to parse them as EFI_SIGNATURE_LIST.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The TODO at :81 is a standing invitation; whoever implements it must write the same 'skip SignatureHeaderSize vendor bytes before the entry region' logic in a separate package with its own efiGUID (:47-52) and UEFI_VARIABLE_DATA parsing (:206-231), and would omit it because the advisory names attest/internal only.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The authority decode path parseEfiSignature, which builds the trusted PreSeparatorAuthority/PostSeparatorAuthority certificate lists from a GUID+data record, with a shim-compatibility fallback that re-parses the raw buffer.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer extending authority handling to hash records, or firmware that logs a signature list in an EV_EFI_VARIABLE_AUTHORITY event, would need the same offset skip; the existing fallback at :481-488 shows the codebase already re-interprets malformed shim buffers, so a sibling skip there is plausible.

O9_family: Improper input validation / improper validation of a specified offset (CWE-1285, CWE-20): an attacker-controlled length field in a parsed binary structure is bounded but never honoured, so vendor bytes are decoded as trusted signature entries and injected into the trusted key/hash list.
